test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Girls students of the Sciences group in the Low category of Addiction form what percentage of the total student sample?
solution:
**Given:**

Number of girls in the Sciences group in the Low category = 23

Total number of students surveyed = 500

**Formula used:**

Percentage = dfrac{{part}}{{total}} times 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ Percentage = dfrac{23}{500} times 100

⇒ Percentage = 4.6%

**∴ Girls students of the Sciences group in the Low category form 4.6% of the total student sample.**
